findings.one_line: The proposed all-feedback-set FPT oracle is replaced by this evaluated XP theorem: the vertex-cover and identical-star subclasses do not establish the promised heterogeneous forest closure or eliminate the (nb)^{O(k)} state dependence.
The bibliography cites Leung2022ApproximateNeighborhood, but the related-work narrative supplies no relevance sentence or comparison for it, contrary to the targeted-positioning requirement.
